name: [ARMOR] Kyoeki: The Madness Plague
desc:
ATTENTION: This game is still in development. There may be bugs. I work on it 100% solo. I am hard at work making more features and content for DAILY UPDATES. Have fun!

This game is supported on PC, Mobile, XBOX and PlayStation.
Weekends: 2x Ryo!
Private Servers save data if no cheats are used.

CAUTION: Flashing lights.

You can buy Clan Robes for your Roblox avatar in the Group Store!

In the year 1570, Japan is ravaged by a virus when a trading ship returns from China. The afflicted become malevolent, driven mad by some peculiar demon that drives them to cruelty and murder. They kill everyone who does not share their affliction and show no mercy. They are the Jatsuki - the wicked.

The warring clans of Japan now fight for their lives. Will you live to see another spring?

- Glitch abuse is punished.
- Exploiting, Ban Evading or Voteban Abuse will lead to a permanent ban.
- Toxicity is not allowed.

COMING SOON:
- Kicking
- Dodging

 Pronounced "Key-yo-eh-key"
